newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel firms on buying, paper value.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel firms on buying, paper value.

text.p: NWE high sulphur fuel oil prices firmed on Monday, with barge values pushed up by aggressive bidding from one dominant player, traders said.
High sulphur fuel barges jumped $2 to $90 fob by mid-morning with little business done later. The trader bought some 11-12,000 tonnes at $89 and another 1-2,000 at $90.
"They are pricing some cargo on the back of this buying," said one trader. "There are no other buyers at the moment."
High sulphur cargoes firmed gently as well, heartened by stronger swaps and stable crude futures, but the market was sleepy with little end-user interest and reasonable supply.
Tight prompt supply and the pickup in paper values pushed up prices on the low sulphur barge market. Offers were $96 on Friday and $95 today, with bids around $93.

Low sulphur cargoes were reported to be plentiful. One load was heard traded to a British industrial user at the end of last week at $98 cif, with the discount to quoted prices reflecting slightly poorer quality, trader said. - Sean Maguire, London newsroom +44 171 542 8060
